title: The Pots That Cracked Before the Fair
central_conflict: the pottery stall's newest bowls cracked during their first firing
decisive_choice: the thick clay bases had retained moisture that expanded as steam
resolution: dried a test batch thoroughly before firing and remade the damaged bowls
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the pottery stall's newest bowls cracked during their first firing during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they lowered the furnace temperature but the next bowls still split; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the thick clay bases had retained moisture that expanded as steam; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they dried a test batch thoroughly before firing and remade the damaged bowls, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Tickets Nobody Could Read
central_conflict: the school fair's winning ticket numbers vanished under the festival lights
decisive_choice: a colored filter over the stage lamps made the ticket ink blend into the paper
resolution: read the originals under neutral lamps and printed high-contrast replacements
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the school fair's winning ticket numbers vanished under the festival lights during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
